Canvas with FocusListener retaining the fullscreen Frame and overriding update.
Implements MouseWheelListener and accumulates wheel movement.
Long key with two sibling links, the shared intrusive node base of most Hold the Line classes.
Applet/Runnable with focus and window listeners; base of the game client.
Canvas retaining a Component and forwarding paint/update.
GameAppletShell subclass that HoldTheLine extends.
ImageProducer/ImageObserver that publishes the pixel buffer to AWT consumers.
Linked abstract audio stream that mixes into an int buffer and has sub-streams.

namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
